topoImageForm.addTopoImageDescription: Upload one or more topo images. After the upload, add a title, description and GPS position for each image. The wall should take up most of the picture and the whole line should be easy to see. Several images are useful, for example, for traverses or lines that run around an edge.
topoImageForm.topoImageDescriptionPlaceh: Interesting things about the wall. Is there, for example, a typical line style? Does it have a special history?
